messages:
Maya (CS): @here quick heads-up — we have a small but noisy onboarding interruption affecting ~12 recently onboarded tenants (SSO flows failing intermittently). Need a short customer-facing status now and an RCA followup. Can someone draft a 2-line status + next steps we can send to affected accounts?
Zoe - AM: On it. Draft below, please edit: ```Hi — we’re investigating intermittent SSO failures affecting some new onboarders. Engineers have deployed a mitigation; we expect normal flows to resume within 90 minutes. We’ll follow up with a root cause and any tenant-impact notes. If you need immediate help, reply here or contact your AM.```
Maya (CS): Nice start. Add mention of credits and a proactive enablement session offer. Keep it empathetic and actionable.
Jonas (SRE): TL;DR: issue was an auth cache invalidation after a config push — mitigation = rolling cache TTL fix + restart of the auth proxy on affected nodes. Mitigation deployed at 13:22 UTC. Observability shows error rate down 85%. ETA for full recovery: 45-60 mins while caches repopulate.
Priya (Onboard): I have the list of 12 tenant contacts and two enterprise trial customers who hit errors. I can coordinate 1:1 enablement calls tomorrow 10–2 PT. Should I include a calendly link in the message or ask them to reply?
Zoe - AM: Don’t add Calendly in the initial status. Say "reply to this thread or ping your AM to schedule". We’ll send the Calendly in the follow-up credit/enablement note.
Maya (CS): Updated draft — please sanity check: ```Hi — we’re currently investigating intermittent SSO sign-in failures affecting a small set of new onboarders. Our engineers implemented a mitigation at 13:22 UTC and sign-in errors have dropped ~85%. We expect full recovery within the hour as caches repopulate. We’ll follow up with a detailed RCA and offer account credits and a complimentary enablement session to ensure a smooth launch. If you need immediate assistance, reply to this message or contact your AM.```
Jonas (SRE): Looks accurate. One ask: include the incident reference ID so tracking is clear. Use INC-2026-0421.
Maya (CS): Good call — added. Final check before I send to the 12 contacts.
Elliot (deploy-bot): deploy: mitigation-auth-cache-fix v2.1 deployed to prod at 2026-04-21T13:22:37Z :white_check_mark:
Priya (Onboard): Sending now to the 12 contacts with the AM cc. I’ll also open calendar slots and follow up with a personalized note offering a 30-min walkthrough.
Zoe - AM: Thanks team. After customers ack recovery, CS will send the formal RCA + credit offer draft for legal signoff. I’ll flag any renewal-risk customers for a follow-up touch. :thumbsup:
Maya (CS): Sending the message now. I’ll add the incident ID and tag the affected accounts in the CRM entry. Will post RCA draft in this thread once ready. :rotating_light:
notes: thread is a short coordination chat to prepare proactive customer communications and enablement coordination after an SSO onboarding interruption
